units: Lev. R. s. 1, beg. (ref. to Ps. CIII, 20, sq.) עליונים ע״י שהן יכולין לעמוד בתַפְקִידָיו של וכ׳ because the celestial beings can stand by (always fulfill) the orders of the Lord, the text says, bless the Lord, ye all his hosts: but as to the earthly beings, who cannot (always) stand by the orders of the Lord, the text says, ‘bless the Lord, ye his messengers’; Yalk. Ps. 860 בתַפְקִידוֹ (sing.).

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:4:1">Koh. R. to I, 4</cite> <he>דור ע״י שאינו עומד בתפקידיו וכ׳</he> a generation of men, because it does not abide by the orders of the Lord, decays, but the earth, which does abide &c.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:4:5">Ib.</cite> <he>תַּפְקִידֶיהָ וכ׳</he> (<he>מעמדת</he>) the earth preserves her trusts (fruits preserved in the ground or by admixtures of earth).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:2:3">Y. Ber. V, 9ᵇ</cite> top <he>תפקידיה</he>, v. <cite ref="V00851">next w.</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: visit, attendance, esp. copulation; בקש ת׳ to seek copulation, long for.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 13">Gen. R. s. 13</cite> <he>בשעה שהמטר … תַּפְקִידָהּ</he> when the rain falls (in the spring), the cattle ruts.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite>, end <he>אתה מבקש תַּפְקִידְךָ … תַּפְקִידוֹ</he> thou hast sexual desires, and has Jechoniah none? <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:30">Lam. R. to I, 4</cite> <he>הכל מבקשין תַּפְקִידָן</he> all things have natural instincts; <he>אפי׳ ארזים מבקשין תַּפְקִידָן</he> even cedars have their instincts (love their native climate); <he>אפי׳ דרכים מבקשין תפקידן</he> even roads have their desires (mourn when they are deserted); a. e.
